zh.plugin.name: teldrive 一键部署
zh.plugin.desc: 部署 teldrive 服务、登录 Telegram、建频道与机器人、创建 rclone 远程并挂载
zh.env.title: 环境检查
zh.deploy.title: 部署
zh.deploy.done: 部署完成，signing-key 与 data-key 已写入配置
zh.deploy.elevated: 当前以管理员身份运行：PostgreSQL 拒绝以提权令牌启动，建议改用「已有数据库」或 docker，否则请以普通权限重启 RCGUI
zh.deploy.pg_download: 下载 PostgreSQL 便携版（约 22 MB）…
zh.deploy.untar_fail: 解包 PostgreSQL 失败：{0}（便携版要用到 tar 命令；Windows 10 1803 起自带，老系统请改用「已有数据库」）
zh.deploy.need_db_url: 选了「已有数据库」就必须填连接串，例如 postgres://postgres:密码@127.0.0.1:5432/teldrive?sslmode=disable；手边没有现成的库，就把数据库方式改成「便携数据库」
zh.deploy.docker_missing: 没找到 docker，无法用容器建库：请装 Docker Desktop，或把数据库方式改成「便携数据库」
zh.deploy.db_existing_skip: 使用已有数据库，跳过自动建库
zh.deploy.check_warn: 配置校验返回非零（{0}），已继续启动；若启动失败请看日志末尾
zh.deploy.health_fail: 健康检查未通过（{0}），请查看日志 {1}
zh.deploy.pg_not_ready: 便携数据库进程在跑，但 {0} 端口连不上；请看 {1}
zh.svc.title: 服务
zh.svc.not_deployed: 尚未部署，请先执行一键部署
zh.svc.instant_exit: teldrive 启动后立刻退出，请查看日志末尾：{0}
zh.svc.health_wait: teldrive 已启动，但健康检查还没通过（HTTP {0}）；首次启动要建表，等几秒再点「刷新」
zh.svc.no_handle: 找不到该进程的句柄（可能由外部启动），请手动结束占用端口 {0} 的进程
zh.svc.log_hint: 日志文件：{0}（最后几行通常写着为什么起不来）
zh.login.title: Telegram 登录
zh.login.phone_hint: 填国际格式手机号，例如 +8613800138000
zh.login.code_hint: 验证码会发到该账号的 Telegram 与短信
zh.login.sent: 验证码已发送（{0} 分钟内有效）
zh.login.sent_at: 验证码已发送，{0} 前有效
zh.login.need_password: 该账号开启了两步验证，请填密码后点「提交两步密码」
zh.login.phone_bad: 手机号要写成国际格式，例如 +8613800138000（+ 号后 8-15 位数字）
zh.logout.done: 已退出登录：本机凭证已清除，已建好的远程仍可用
zh.login.expired: 登录流程已失效，请重新点「发送验证码」
zh.login.reauth: 登录已过期，请重新扫码或重新点「手机登录」
zh.login.need_login: 还没登录 Telegram，请先扫码或点「手机登录」
zh.login.key_fail: 创建 API key 失败：{0}
zh.login.secret_missing: 服务端没有返回 key，请打开 teldrive 的 Settings → API keys 自查
zh.qr.ready: 已生成二维码，请用手机 Telegram 的「链接桌面设备」扫码；扫完点「检查扫码结果」
zh.qr.write_fail: 二维码画出来了，但存到磁盘失败：{0}
zh.qr.expired: 二维码已过期，请重新点「扫码登录」
zh.qr.need_password: 扫码成功，但该账号开了两步验证，请填两步密码后点「提交两步密码」
zh.qr.waiting: 还没检测到扫码确认；手机上确认后，再点一次「检查扫码结果」
zh.qr.rewritten: 还没检测到扫码确认，二维码已换新：面板里现在是新码，请重新扫
zh.qr.none: 还没有二维码，请先点「扫码登录」
zh.qr.no_url: 服务端没返回二维码内容：{0}
zh.qr.too_long: 二维码内容有 {0} 字节，超过插件能画的上限（约 660 字节），画不出来；请改用手机号+验证码登录
zh.channel.title: 频道与机器人
zh.channel.need_name: 先填一个频道名：留空时服务端会按前缀自动命名，事后不容易分辨是哪一个
zh.bot.hint: 机器人需先在 @BotFather 里手动创建：发 /newbot 取名 → 复制 token → 每行一个粘贴到上面
zh.bot.added: 已添加 {0} 个机器人，后台 provisioning 任务已提交
zh.bot.failed: 有 {0} 个 token 未被接受（索引 {1}）
zh.bot.need_token: 请至少填一个机器人 token
zh.channel.list_empty: 账号下还没有频道，填个名字点「创建频道」
zh.channel.pick_first: 先在下拉里选一个频道
zh.bot.pick_first: 先在上面选一台机器人
zh.remote.title: 远程与挂载
zh.remote.need_login: 请先登录 Telegram 后再创建远程
zh.remote.need_key: 创建 API key 失败：{0}
zh.remote.bad_name: 远程名不能含 : / \ 这三个字符
zh.remote.create_fail: 创建远程失败：{0}。若提示 unknown backend，说明当前连着的 rclone 不是 tgdrive 的 fork
zh.remote.rclone_missing: 找不到 rclone 可执行文件，请先部署或选择已有的 rclone
zh.mount.bad_drive: 盘符格式应为 T: 或 T:\
zh.mount.already: 已经挂载到 {0}，请先卸载再重新挂载
zh.mount.rc_hint: 「挂载后让 RCGUI 接管连接」勾选时，RCGUI 的 RC 地址会被设为该 rclone 实例
zh.mount.no_cmount: 当前 rclone 没有编译挂载支持（构建标签：{0}）。Windows 上挂载需要带 cmount 标签的二进制，仓库里附带的 rclone-v1.76.0（tgdrive fork）就有
zh.hint.teldrive: 端口用于 teldrive 的 HTTP 服务，仅监听 127.0.0.1
zh.hint.db: 自动模式：先看本机 5432 有没有 PostgreSQL，再试 docker，最后才下载 22 MB 的便携版
zh.hint.portable: 便携版下载 22 MB、解压约 97 MB 到数据目录；手边已经有 PostgreSQL 就不必用它
zh.hint.data_dir: 留空则用 RCGUI 数据目录下的 plugins\teldrive
zh.proxy.not_deployed: 还没有部署 teldrive，先在上面点「一键部署」
zh.proxy.bad: 代理地址要以 http://、https:// 或 socks5:// 开头
zh.proxy.cleared: 已清空代理设置，teldrive 恢复直连
zh.proxy.no_handle: config.yaml 已改好，但找不到 teldrive 的进程句柄；请手动点「停止」再「启动」让新配置生效
zh.proxy.stop_fail: config.yaml 已改好，但没能停掉正在运行的 teldrive（{0} 端口还通）；请手动关掉它再点「启动」，否则跑的还是旧配置

en.plugin.name: teldrive setup
en.plugin.desc: Deploy teldrive, sign in to Telegram, create channel and bot, add an rclone remote and mount it
en.env.title: Environment
en.deploy.title: Deploy
en.deploy.done: Done. signing-key and data-key were written into the config
en.deploy.elevated: Running elevated: PostgreSQL refuses to start from an elevated token. Use an existing database or docker, or restart RCGUI without elevation
en.deploy.untar_fail: Could not unpack PostgreSQL: {0} (the portable database needs a tar command; Windows 10 1803 and later ship one — on older systems choose "existing database")
en.deploy.need_db_url: With an existing database the connection string is required, e.g. postgres://postgres:secret@127.0.0.1:5432/teldrive?sslmode=disable; if you have no server yet, switch the database mode to Portable
en.deploy.docker_missing: docker was not found, so the database cannot be created in a container. Install Docker Desktop, or switch to the portable database
en.deploy.db_existing_skip: Using an existing database, skipping creation
en.deploy.check_warn: Config check exited {0}; continuing. If startup fails, read the log tail
en.deploy.health_degraded: Service is up but reports degraded ({0})
en.deploy.pg_start_fail: The portable database did not start: {0}
en.deploy.pg_not_ready: The portable database is running, but port {0} is not accepting connections — see {1}
en.svc.title: Service
en.svc.pg_start_fail: The portable database did not start: {0}
en.svc.not_deployed: Not deployed yet; run the deployment first
en.svc.instant_exit: teldrive exited right after starting; see the end of the log: {0}
en.svc.health_wait: teldrive started but its health check has not passed yet (HTTP {0}); the first run creates tables, so give it a few seconds and press Refresh
en.svc.no_handle: No handle for that process (started elsewhere). End the process holding port {0} manually
en.svc.log_hint: Log file: {0} (its last lines usually say why it did not start)
en.login.title: Telegram sign-in
en.login.code_hint: The code arrives in Telegram and by SMS
en.login.need_password: Two-step verification is enabled; enter the password and press the password button
en.login.phone_bad: Use the international form, e.g. +8613800138000 (8-15 digits after +)
en.logout.done: Signed out: this machine no longer holds the credentials; existing remotes keep working
en.login.expired: The login flow expired; request a new code
en.login.reauth: The session expired; scan the QR code again or use phone sign-in
en.login.need_login: Not signed in to Telegram yet; scan the QR code or use phone sign-in
en.login.secret_missing: The server returned no key; check Settings -> API keys in teldrive
en.qr.ready: QR code ready: scan it with Telegram on your phone (Settings -> Devices -> Link Desktop Device), then press "Check scan"
en.qr.write_fail: The QR code was drawn but saving it failed: {0}
en.qr.expired: The QR code expired; press "Scan to sign in" again
en.qr.need_password: Scan confirmed, but this account has two-step verification: enter the password and press "Submit two-step password"
en.qr.waiting: No confirmation yet; after confirming on your phone, press "Check scan" again
en.qr.rewritten: No confirmation yet; the panel shows a fresh QR code now - scan it again
en.qr.none: No QR code yet; press "Scan to sign in" first
en.qr.no_url: The server returned no QR content: {0}
en.qr.too_long: The QR content is {0} bytes, past what this plugin can encode (~660 bytes), so no code was drawn; sign in with a phone number and code instead
en.channel.title: Channel and bot
en.channel.need_name: Enter a name; left empty the server names it from the prefix and you cannot tell channels apart later
en.bot.hint: Create the bot manually in @BotFather: /newbot, then paste its token, one per line
en.bot.need_token: Paste at least one bot token
en.channel.list_empty: No channel yet — enter a name and click Create channel
en.channel.pick_first: Pick a channel from the list first
en.bot.list_empty: This account has no bot yet
en.remote.title: Remote and mount
en.remote.need_login: Sign in to Telegram before creating the remote
en.remote.create_fail: Cannot create the remote: {0}. An "unknown backend" error means the connected rclone is not the tgdrive fork
en.remote.rclone_missing: rclone binary not found; deploy first or point at an existing rclone
en.mount.bad_drive: Drive must look like T: or T:\
en.mount.already: Already mounted at {0}; unmount it before mounting again
en.mount.rc_hint: When the hand-off checkbox is on, RCGUI's RC endpoint is pointed at this rclone instance
en.mount.no_cmount: This rclone was built without mount support (build tags: {0}). Mounting on Windows needs a binary built with the cmount tag — the bundled rclone-v1.76.0 (tgdrive fork) has it
en.hint.teldrive: Port of teldrive's HTTP service; it listens on 127.0.0.1 only
en.hint.db: auto: probe local 5432, then docker if present, and only then download the 22 MB portable build
en.hint.portable: The portable build downloads 22 MB and extracts ~97 MB into the data directory; skip it if you already have PostgreSQL
en.proxy.not_deployed: teldrive is not deployed yet; run the one-click deploy first
en.proxy.bad: The proxy URL must start with http://, https:// or socks5://
en.proxy.cleared: Proxy cleared; teldrive goes direct again
en.proxy.no_handle: config.yaml is updated, but the teldrive process handle is unknown; stop and start the service manually
en.proxy.stop_fail: config.yaml is updated, but the running teldrive could not be stopped (port {0} is still open); stop it yourself and press Start, otherwise the old configuration stays in effect
